review_note: Author draft (session 1); not yet independently reviewed. All tasks are test split. | Reviewed 2026-10-01: author and reviewer were separate sessions without retrieval tools; review log in evals/out/m12/heldout_zod_review_log.md.

tasks.query: transparent proxy that lazily builds its target from a getter on first access and forwards get, set, has, deleteProperty, ownKeys, getOwnPropertyDescriptor and defineProperty
tasks.note: Single function; every Proxy trap lazily calls the getter once (target ??= getter()) then delegates to Reflect.

tasks.query: Russian plural chooser returning the one, few or many noun form from a count's last digit, with 11 through 19 always many
tasks.note: Belarusian be.ts has a near-identical helper, but the query says Russian; gold is the ru.ts function.

tasks.query: Legacy v3 helper listing the primitive values a discriminator field schema accepts: literals, enums, null, undefined, seeing through lazy, effects, branded, readonly and catch wrappers
tasks.note: v3 module-level const arrow function used by ZodDiscriminatedUnion.create; v4 uses propValues instead.

tasks.query: Convert a ZodError into a nested tree with errors arrays, string keys under properties and array indexes under items, recursing into union branches
tasks.note: Overloaded; def_line is the implementation signature. Also recurses into invalid_key and invalid_element.

tasks.query: Group open issues and pull requests with similar titles into duplicate clusters using Jaccard similarity of title tokens, merged with union-find, largest cluster first
tasks.note: Repo maintenance script (not library code). jaccard and titleTokens are helpers; findClusters does the grouping and sort.

tasks.query: Resolve a local $ref pointer to its target in the root schema, picking $defs or definitions by draft version and rejecting external refs
tasks.note: Only local '#' refs: '#' returns rootSchema, '#/$defs|definitions/name' returns the def; anything else throws.

tasks.query: Rewrite an anyOf whose branches are all bare type assertions into a single type array, compacting nested unions first and bailing on constrained branches
tasks.note: Recursive in-place rewrite used by finalize; single-member result is a bare string, not an array.

tasks.query: Benchmark generator writing a chain of object schemas for zod, valibot or arktype that alternately omits three keys and extends with three new keys
tasks.note: Other package (packages/tsc). The only other exported generator there is generate(); it does not alternate omit/extend.

tasks.query: Merge synchronous key and value parse results into a final object, aborting on invalid entries, ignoring __proto__ keys and undefined values unless alwaysSet
tasks.note: v3 static method; mergeObjectAsync only awaits and then delegates to this one.

tasks.query: Check an IPv6 CIDR string by splitting at the single slash, requiring a canonical decimal prefix between 0 and 128 and a valid address
tasks.note: Exported helper, also hoisted by compile.ts; the v4 IPv4 CIDR is validated by regex only.

tasks.query: Walk the syntax tree's leading and trailing trivia to find double-slash annotations alone on a row, returning a map from zero-based row to trimmed text
tasks.note: Name tokens own/line/comments and stem check/comments are avoided. Uses the TypeScript compiler API trivia ranges.

tasks.query: Armenian helper marking a noun as known by appending one ending after a vowel and another otherwise, giving an empty string for no word
tasks.note: Appends ն after a vowel, ը otherwise; empty string for undefined/empty. Armenian is the only locale with this helper.

tasks.query: Lithuanian helper sorting an integer into singular, paucal or plural class by trailing digits: teens and zero endings plural, one ending singular, others paucal
tasks.note: Returns the label 'one' | 'few' | 'many' (not a word form), unlike the ru/be plural pickers; the last===0 rule is Lithuanian-specific.

tasks.query: Gap between a division result and its nearest integer, zeroed within four machine epsilons scaled by the quotient, for decimal multiple checks
tasks.note: v3/types.ts has a different function of the same name (decimal-count scaling); the four-epsilon tolerance is only in the v4 core one.

tasks.query: Convert required_error, invalid_type_error and message options into a single error map, throwing when a custom error map is combined with the specific messages
tasks.note: v3 internal helper behind every Zod*.create(); throws when errorMap is combined with invalid_type_error or required_error.

tasks.query: Bank account checksum folding letters into two-digit values and keeping the running remainder modulo ninety-seven while reading the first four characters last, expecting one
tasks.note: Private helper; isValidIBAN only adds a regex test and calls it. Query describes the checksum loop, which is only here.

tasks.query: Format key segments as an accessor string: indexes in square brackets, symbols and awkward names quoted inside brackets, plain names joined by periods
tasks.note: Used by prettifyError; segments may be PropertyKey or Standard Schema PathSegment objects.

tasks.query: Look up a schema's metadata layered over its parent's inherited metadata, excluding the id, returning undefined when the merged result has no keys
tasks.note: Recursive over _zod.parent; 'do not inherit id'. Registry.has/add/remove are not equally valid.

tasks.query: Run a callback with the code writer nested one level deeper, then restore the previous depth even if the callback throws
tasks.note: try/finally around indent += 1; the finally exists because compile.ts catches child throws and keeps writing to the same Doc.

tasks.query: Deprecated legacy-API shim passing a user callback that produces issue text into the library-wide configuration function under its custom handler option
tasks.note: DOUBTFUL: v3/errors.ts also defines a setErrorMap (module-level override). Only the classic shim forwards into config({customError}).

tasks.query: Recursively make every nested object's properties optional, with a classic and a mini entry point both delegating to the shared bottom-up schema rewriter
tasks.note: visit is overloaded; def_line is the implementation signature. classic uses .partial(), mini uses the partial() function.

tasks.query: Convert a registry of id-tagged schemas into JSON Schema documents, extracting unregistered shared parts into a definitions bucket and building refs with a uri callback
tasks.note: Registry branch of toJSONSchema drives two passes; extractDefs.makeURI uses external.uri and the __shared bucket; finalize per schema.

tasks.query: Compiling refuses a schema containing a reference cycle, and the compiled wrapper falls back to the runtime parser for values already hit as cycle back-edges
tasks.note: compileFn and withParser both throw ZodCompileUnsupportedError when isRecursiveSchema; only withParser's wrapper consults isBackEdge.

tasks.query: How v3 builds an issue's message: contextual error map first, then the schema's map, then the user's global override, then the default English map
tasks.note: addIssueToContext assembles the ordered map list (reads getErrorMap); makeIssue folds them in reverse order. v3 only.

tasks.query: Length checks count code points rather than UTF-16 units; the generated validator reuses that counting routine only when raw length cannot settle the outcome
tasks.note: codePointLengthVar hoists util.codePointLength and calls it only when the cheap bound test (inDoubt) holds.

tasks.query: Discriminated union dispatch: runtime builds a value-to-option map rejecting duplicate or missing discriminator values; the compiled path emits an if/else-if chain instead
tasks.note: The compiler does not call discriminatorMap; it re-derives claimed values itself and refuses to compile on duplicates.

tasks.query: String-to-boolean codec accepting yes, no, on, off style words, case-insensitive by default with custom truthy and falsy lists, shared by classic and mini wrappers
tasks.note: Both wrappers pass their own Codec/Boolean/String classes into core _stringbool, which holds all the logic.

tasks.query: Tuples may omit trailing slots that accept undefined: runtime and compiled parsers both find where the omittable tail starts and truncate absent output slots
tasks.note: getTupleOptStart exists twice (runtime and compile mirror); both are gold because the query spans both parsers.

tasks.query: Refinement context whose addIssue accepts a string or legacy issue object, filling in code, input and owner; classic and mini forward to one core builder
tasks.note: Reviewer rewrite (replaces the compile hoisting task). core _superRefine builds the check and installs payload.addIssue (string via util.issue; object gets code custom, input, inst, continue defaults, fatal -> continue false); classic and mini superRefine just forward to it.

tasks.query: Definition names are escaped for ref fragments on export, and the importer undoes that escaping when resolving a ref, reversing slash before tilde
tasks.note: Reviewer rewrite (replaces the template literal pattern task). Exporter half escapes ~ then / when extractDefs builds refs; importer half decodes ~1 then ~0 in resolveRef. resolveRef itself is t06's gold and is not repeated here.

gold_context.why: convertSchema calls convertBaseSchema first to build the type-specific base schema, then layers anyOf/oneOf/allOf, nullable, readOnly and default on top of that result.
Decides whether a propertyNames or contains subschema may be carried into extraMeta; a subschema holding a $ref is dropped.
The public entry point: it builds the ConversionContext (registry, defs, version, rootSchema) and calls convertSchema(normalized, ctx).
convertSchema attaches the collected annotation metadata with ctx.registry.add(baseSchema, extraMeta).
Used to copy every unrecognized keyword into extraMeta via assignProp(extraMeta, key, schema[key]).
Reports the invalid_type issue for a non-object input and the unrecognized_keys issue in strict mode.
The key/value pairs built by _parse are folded into the final object here (directly, or after awaiting in the async path); it decides aborted/dirty, skips __proto__ and honours alwaysSet.
Supplies the shape and key list that _parse iterates over.
Each property is parsed with new ParseInputLazyPath(ctx, value, ctx.path, key), which builds the child path lazily.
_parse tests this._def.catchall instanceof ZodNever to choose between unknownKeys handling and running a catchall schema.
ctx.metadataRegistry.get(schema) supplies the metadata merged into the result, including metadata inherited from parent schemas.
For io 'input' it decides whether examples and default are deleted from the result schema.
Used to merge the registry metadata into result.schema.
The per-schema record (schema, count, cycle, ref, path) that processSchema creates and stores in ctx.seen.
An example of the processors dispatched through ctx.processors[def.type]; it re-enters processSchema for each property and for the catchall.
Normalizes each error callback's return value (a string or an object with message) so the ?? chain can pick the first message produced.
Stamps the owning schema onto issues raised by a check; finalizeIssue reads iss.schema to find that schema's def.error.
The caller: it maps each raw issue through util.finalizeIssue(iss, ctx, core.config()) the first time the error is read.
Returns the global config whose customError and localeError callbacks finalizeIssue consults after the schema-level and per-parse errors.
Declares the per-parse error callback and the reportInput flag that finalizeIssue reads from ctx.
input() delegates the rewrite to visit, which walks the tree bottom-up and passes each handler a flag saying whether a child was rewritten.
The pipe handler: replaces a pipe by its input side, and for z.preprocess (whose in side is a bare transform) falls back to the out side.
inSide calls it when the pipe's in schema is a transform, so the checks carried by the pipe are kept.
The default handler wraps the inner type with schemas.optional when it was rewritten, so the input type still admits undefined.
emit calls extractDefs(this.ctx, schema) to pull shared, id-tagged and cyclic subschemas out into definitions.
emit returns the result of finalize(this.ctx, schema) with the ~standard property stripped.
Must be called before emit; it fills ctx.seen, which extractDefs and finalize read (they throw for an unprocessed schema).
emit can overwrite ctx.cycles, ctx.reused and ctx.external from its params and always resets sharedDefsExtractedFor and sharedEmitDoneFor, all fields declared here.
makeArgsIssue and makeReturnsIssue call it to build the invalid_arguments and invalid_return_type issues from the ordered error maps.
Supplies the global override map placed in the errorMaps list passed to makeIssue.
Reports invalid_type when the parsed input is not a function.
The wrapper throws new ZodError([...]) for argument and return failures, and the async wrapper builds one and calls addIssue on it.
this._def.returns instanceof ZodPromise selects the async wrapper, which parses the resolved result with the promise's inner type.
Picks the one/few/many unit word used in the too_big and too_small messages.
The invalid_type branch calls util.parsedType(issue.input) to name the received type.
Formats the allowed options in the invalid_value message and the key list in the unrecognized_keys message.
Renders the single expected literal in the invalid_value message.
compileFn calls it first and refuses to compile when the schema subtree contains a reference cycle.
compileFn creates new Doc(['input']) to accumulate the generated source lines.
compileFn calls generateCheck(doc, ctx, schema, 'input', ...) to emit the root validation code and obtain the output accessor.
Thrown by compileFn for a cyclic schema and when the generated source fails to evaluate.
compileFn builds this context (constants map, constantCounter, varCounter, definite), hoists its constants into the new Function, and copies ctx.definite onto the returned fn.definite.
Called on each catchall run result, directly or after awaiting, to merge it into the payload with the optin/optout rules for absent keys.
Produces the def whose keySet (string shape keys) handleCatchall uses to skip declared keys.
With abortEarly, handleCatchall calls util.aborted(payload, seen) to stop the key loop once an issue has aborted the payload.
The payload parameter that accumulates issues and the output value.
The ctx parameter, passed through to _catchall.run for each extra key.
